failure: Failure: D_k<=K is required. The divergence optimum is not by itself a finite-sample minimax theorem for every assay. Product and explicit-DNF assumptions are essential to the positive regime. No real failure law or general rare-event capability is established.
interface: Interface: Known d,a,k and a rare conjunction under a Bernoulli product baseline. The negative pair is indistinguishable from supplied low-order marginals; the assay reveals at most k distinct coordinates per fresh specimen. Reusing a specimen to observe more coordinates changes the contract. The positive regime requires true product structure and explicit DNF representation.

claims.title: Exact low-order marginals can leave rare-event probability uncertain at the rare-event scale
